question: What protective gear is required when handling winch cable?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Cause: Handling winch cable without protective gear -> Action: Wear leather gloves when handling winch cable. Do not handle cable with bare hands. [Manual page 4]

**Other relevant information**
• Direct all personnel to stand clear of winch cable during winch operation. [Manual page 4]
• When fully extending winch cable, ensure that four wraps of winch cable remain on drum at all times. [Manual page 4]

**Limitations**
The table only lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
